intuition: Because duplicates are adjacent in a sorted list, each run can be skipped entirely when its value occurs more than once.

brute_force.approach: Copy all node values into a list, count them, then rebuild nodes for values occurring once.

optimal.approach: Use a dummy predecessor and unlink each entire repeated-value run in one scan.

edge_cases: The head itself may be duplicated and removed.
All nodes may belong to duplicate runs.
An empty or singleton list is already duplicate-free.
